description: This file contains implementation code for managing display configurations within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including classes for handling display configs, flag processing, serialization/deserialization, and component registration using the 'fruit' dependency injection framework.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DisplaysConfigs interface, managing a list of display configurations.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFlagImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DisplaysConfigsFlag interface, handling flag processing for display configs.

classes.name: DisplaysConfigsFragmentImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DisplaysConfigsFragment interface, handling serialization and deserialization of display configs.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Returns the current list of display configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets the list of display configurations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the implementation class.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set display configurations.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatHelpXml
methods.description: Writes help XML for Gflags compatibility.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes display configurations into JSON format.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into display configurations.
